entry.title: Acid 3.0.0
entry.summary: Acid 3.0.0: one plugin folder for every MPC, with a new native touchscreen skin. - New: runs on the MPC Live III and other 64-bit MPCs as well as the Force and other 32-bit models. - New: native touchscreen skin with six tabs (SEQ A, EDIT A, SEQ B, EDIT B, MOD, GLOBAL), steady Q-Link and touch behaviour. - Steadier timing while you work the screen: edits no longer share a lock with the note timing, so a busy touchscreen can't hold up a note. - Same generator, blend modes, per-step edit and locks

entry.title: Acid 2.1.0
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force. entry.title: Acid 2.0.0
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## What's new in 2.0.0 - **Edit pages:** EDIT A and EDIT B sit next to their SEQ tab. Per step: ON, a NOTE slider (two scale octaves either side of the root), ACC, SLIDE and LOCK, with 16 steps at a time and a bar switch for steps 17-32. A yellow marker follows the playing step. The 16 Q-Links turn the 16 note sliders. - **Live knobs:** DENSITY, ACCENT, SLIDE, OCTAVES, ALGO, LENGTH and SCALE reshap

entry.title: Acid 1.0.8
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## What's new in 1.0.8 - **Fixed: timing.** Each block's steps are now sent at the start of the block (look-ahead), split at MPC's loop end, so notes land on the beat. - **Changed: Mute button** no longer shows a live name label under it; the touch area is just the lamp. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61)

entry.title: Acid 1.0.7
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## What's new in 1.0.7 - **Fixed: Acid still drifted out of time on fast tempo changes.** The pattern step is now taken from the song position on every 16th, instead of counted from the last one, so whatever MPC does to the position while the tempo moves, the next step lands where it belongs. entry.title: Acid 1.0.6
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## What's new in 1.0.6 - **Fixed: Acid fell out of sync when you changed the tempo.** On every tempo step MPC moves the song position back a little; Acid treated that as a loop and fired some steps twice, which pushed its pattern ahead of the other tracks until you pressed Pause and Play. entry.title: Acid 1.0.5
entry.summary: A TB-303-style acid bassline sequencer (two lines, blendable) that drives a synth track over MIDI. ## What's new in 1.0.5 - **Steps are placed from the song position.** Acid used to count MIDI clock pulses it made from the host's tempo, so a lost pulse, a start in the middle of a beat or a loop wrap could shift every later step. entry.title: Acid 1.0.3
entry.summary: Fixes loading on MPC OS 2.x (glibc 2.32): the plugin is now built against glibc 2.31 and needs only GLIBC_2.17 (the earlier builds bound to GLIBC_2.34). The installer also works on Hakai-enabled systems (service `inmusic-mpc` instead of `acvs`). No other plugin changes.
